content.short: Synergy is a blockchain strategy game on Mantle where players build, battle, and earn through a player-owned economy of NFT game assets.
content.description: Synergy is an on-chain strategy game built on the Mantle Network that combines tactical gameplay with a fully player-owned economy. Players collect, upgrade, and deploy NFT units and resources to build their forces and compete against others in strategic battles. All in-game assets are tokenized as NFTs, giving players true ownership and the ability to trade freely on secondary markets. The game's economy rewards skilled players with cryptocurrency earnings, creating a genuine play-to-earn loop on Mantle.
